| **task** | Mining formulaic alphas (trading signals/factors) via human-AI interaction, using LLMs to translate researchers' trading ideas into alpha expressions and refine them. | “In this work, we propose a new alpha mining paradigm by introducing human-AI interaction, and a novel prompt engineering algorithmic framework to implement this paradigm by leveraging the power of large language models.” |
| **architecture** | Agentic workflow of ideation (Trading Idea Polisher with database), implementation (Quant Developer LLM generates seed alphas, genetic programming enhances them), and review (Analyst agent with backtest engine); WebUI, AlphaBot LLM agent with RAG, algorithmic mining and acceleration layers. | “It is a multi-layered framework composed of a user-facing interface, a core LLM agent, an algorithmic mining engine, and a computation acceleration layer.” |
